required_human_actions: Legal authority must approve, reject or condition the field-level rights matrix.
Privacy/Data Rights authority must approve a lawful basis, minimisation, retention, deletion and data-subject-rights handling.

observations: Unless otherwise noted, procurement notices published in the Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union are presented as freely reusable for commercial or non-commercial purposes.
SIMAP editorial content is presented under CC BY 4.0, requiring appropriate credit and indication of changes.
SIMAP metadata is presented as dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
Additional rights may be required for identifiable individuals and third-party works.
Software, patents, trademarks, registered designs, logos and names are excluded from the general reuse policy; TED logos require prior consent.
TED notices can contain professional contact details and, in some award notices, names of natural-person tenderers.
TED states that personal data in public notices is retained on the website for ten years, then archived internally.
TED disclaims completeness, accuracy and currency and identifies electronically signed OJ S notices as authentic.

observations: The Search API is presented as providing access to published procurement notices for analysis and reuse.
The API supports bulk XML retrieval and is presented as openly accessible without authentication.
The documentation explicitly identifies commercial organisations integrating TED data into value-added platforms as an intended user class.

observations: TED provides direct daily and monthly XML packages without sign-in.
Daily editions are published Monday to Friday; daily XML packages are stated to be available by 09:30 on publication day.
The Search API is described as read-only.

observations: The Decision establishes commercial and non-commercial reuse as the general principle for covered documents.
Reuse must respect personal-data protection rules.
Third-party intellectual property, industrial property, logos and names are outside the general reuse grant.
Conditions may include source acknowledgement, preservation of original meaning and Commission non-liability.
The Decision supports machine-readable structured data, linking, caching and value-added information services.
